text:
Zara Ahmed: Hi everyone! I’m Zara, joining today as a Software Engineer on the runtime team. Quick intro + setup thread. I’m CA-PST, planning to visit the SF office next Tuesday. Two truths and a lie: I can juggle chainsaws (no, really), I once backpacked across Portugal, I make a mean homemade pasta. Which one is the lie? :thinking:

Nora Kim: Welcome Zara!! :tada: Adding you to #eng-runtime. For office day, ping me and we’ll coordinate lunch. Chainsaws?? Definitely a strong candidate for the lie.

IT Support: Hi Zara, welcome! Please submit hardware + access requests at https://redwood.internal/it-requests. If you post your GitHub handle we can pre-stage repo invites and create a ticket for yubikey + VPN if needed.

Zara Ahmed: GitHub handle: zara-ahmed. Quick issue: tried cloning a private repo and got a 403. Command and output below:

```
$ git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/llm-runtime.git
Cloning into 'llm-runtime'...
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```

Anyone have a fast workaround while IT opens the ticket?

Marta Li: try `ssh -T git@github.com` first to check key. If you see "Hi <name>! You've successfully authenticated" then keys are fine. Otherwise generate with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"zara@redwood.ai\"` and add the public key to GitHub. On mac: `pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`. Happy to screenshare for 10m.

Onboarder Bot: Welcome Zara Ahmed! Buddy assigned: Marta Li. Onboarding checklist created. Next action: schedule a 30m runtime sync with team.

Zara Ahmed: Thanks all, I pasted my public key into the IT form and filed the request. I’ll take Marta up on the screenshare if the invite doesn’t come through. Also I can confirm the chainsaw is a lie 602 See you next week for lunch!
